channel.title: Valentine Tide
channel.description: Gothic surf clothing and swimwear, printed to order.

item.g:title: Valentine Tide Wordmark Tee, Heavyweight garment dyed tee, black, size S
item.g:description: The first wave. Bone and blood wordmark on a heavyweight, garment dyed black tee. Relaxed fit, soft hand, built to fade like salt worn rubber. 6.1 oz ring spun cotton. Garment dyed for a soft, lived in feel. Relaxed, boxy fit. Chest print about 10 inches wide.

item.g:title: Valentine Tide Night Session Rash Guard, Men's long sleeve rash guard, black, size XS
item.g:description: Built for the dark water. Near black with a tonal thorn and wave pattern and the full Surf the Shadows arch across the back: a blood moon over a breaking wave, framed in thorns and roses, above the Valentine Tide lettering. The arch scene sits on the chest, a red rose on the right cuff, and Surf the Shadows runs down the left sleeve. Four way stretch, 78% polyester, 22% elastane. Long sleeves and a longer body for sun and wind. Flat seams that won't rub on the board. Black stitching, printed edge to edge.
